name: @airferry/sender
description: AirFerry sender — Chrome/Edge/Firefox extension that streams QR codes.

scripts.postinstall: node scripts/patch-parcel-dev-server.cjs && node scripts/extract-lzma-wasm.cjs && node scripts/prepare-plasmo-icon.cjs
scripts.build: node scripts/extract-lzma-wasm.cjs && node scripts/prepare-plasmo-icon.cjs && node scripts/build-wasm.cjs && node scripts/build-all.cjs
scripts.build:chrome-mv3: node scripts/extract-lzma-wasm.cjs && node scripts/prepare-plasmo-icon.cjs && node scripts/build-all.cjs chrome-mv3
scripts.build:chrome-mv2: node scripts/extract-lzma-wasm.cjs && node scripts/prepare-plasmo-icon.cjs && node scripts/build-all.cjs chrome-mv2
scripts.build:firefox-mv3: node scripts/extract-lzma-wasm.cjs && node scripts/prepare-plasmo-icon.cjs && node scripts/build-all.cjs firefox-mv3
scripts.build:firefox-mv2: node scripts/extract-lzma-wasm.cjs && node scripts/prepare-plasmo-icon.cjs && node scripts/build-all.cjs firefox-mv2

manifest.name: AirFerry - 无网文件传输
manifest.description: 通过屏幕二维码视频流，无网传输文件到手机。无需网络、蓝牙、USB。
